candidates.name: First Branchial Cleft Anomaly
support_spans: unilateral otomandibular syndrome (OMS) associated with severe temporal bone hypoplasia
discharge through the artificial ear canal
fistula originating from the middle ear
millimetric fistula at the tip of the mastoid running into the sternocleidomastoid muscle
candidates.why: The combination of unilateral otomandibular syndrome, temporal bone hypoplasia, and a fistula originating from the middle ear with discharge through the artificial ear canal suggests a congenital anomaly, which is consistent with a First Branchial Cleft Anomaly.
